name: State changes in one wakeup are spoken one after another
step: State changes in one wakeup are spoken one after another
rationale:
Ported from rotorflight-lua-ethos-suite PR #2575 (issue #2503): the wakeup of
tasks/audio_events.lua ran the arming, profile, battery and governor announcements back to
back with no gate between them, so the radio cut each file with the next one. Only the
adjustment path checked canSpeak(). The four state changes now go through the same gate,
and a change that has to wait is held out of `previous`, so it is compared again on the next
wakeup and spoken once.

The harness drives the real task on a controllable clock and logs every file and number it
asks for with the time it was asked. It checks that two changes in one wakeup are spoken in
separate wakeups, that a single change is still spoken at once, that a governor change waits
behind a profile announcement, that a thrust vector profile change waits behind the rate profile,
and that a change still waiting when the link drops is not spoken after a reconnect. Against
unpatched master four of the checks fail.
